submitted.rationale: Ag:Sb ≈ 1:1 matches AgSbO3, a known visible-light absorber with a band gap of about 2.6 eV, below the 2.7 eV illumination. It gave the highest EQE (0.369%) of the three measurements. EQE fell off on both sides: 0.258% at Ag 0.62 and 0.196% at Ag 0.40.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.258% EQE, which is lower. It is Ag-rich, likely with an Ag/Ag2O secondary phase.
Measured 0.196% EQE, which is lower. It is Sb-rich, likely with a wide-gap Sb oxide diluting the absorber.
